meta.prompt: Show the plan for migrating my blog as steps: six steps with a short description each. A start button runs them one after another (a second or two each) with a spinner on the running step, ticks on the finished ones, a progress bar and the time elapsed, a pause button, and a summary when all are done.
meta.text:
ChatCard "Blog migration" "Six steps, run one after another" icon:"swap_horiz" status:"Ready"
  each s in steps
    PlanStep title:=s.title detail:=s.detail index:=s.i current:=done running:=running
  ProgressLine "Progress" "" value:=done/6
  Row gap:10
    ActionButton "Start" primary icon:"play_arrow" enabled:=!running -> running=true; done=0
    ActionButton "Pause" quiet icon:"pause" enabled:=running -> running=false

state running=false
state done=0
state elapsed=0
every 1000 -> elapsed=elapsed+1
every 1s when running -> done=min(6,done+1); running=done<5

state steps=[{"i":0,"title":"Export posts","detail":"Download all posts and drafts from the old platform."},{"i":1,"title":"Convert format","detail":"Turn HTML content into Markdown with metadata."},{"i":2,"title":"Move media","detail":"Copy images and attachments to the new storage."},{"i":3,"title":"Fix links","detail":"Rewrite internal URLs and set up redirects."},{"i":4,"title":"Restore comments","detail":"Import comments and map them to their posts."},{"i":5,"title":"Verify and switch DNS","detail":"Check every page, then point the domain at the new site."}]
